question:
A plane transmission diffraction grating has $500$ lines per mm. A parallel monochromatic beam of wavelength $\lambda=600\,\text{nm}$ illuminates a width of $2.0\,\text{cm}$ of the grating.

The grating is used in the highest possible order for this wavelength.Determine 

(i) the maximum possible order $m_{\max}$, 

(ii) the minimum wavelength separation $\Delta\lambda_{\min}$ between two close spectral lines near $600\,\text{nm}$ that can be just resolved (Rayleigh criterion) in that highest order.
